meanings.en: the day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday
meanings.exampleEn: I have a meeting every Monday morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Her pazartesi sabahı bir toplantım var.

meanings.en: a sound, especially a voice, that stays on one level and does not change
meanings.exampleEn: He read the report in a dull monotone.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu sıkıcı, monoton bir sesle okudu.

meanings.en: boring because it stays the same and does not change
meanings.exampleEn: The work was monotonous and repetitive.
meanings.exampleTr: İş tekdüze ve tekrara dayalıydı.

meanings.en: resembling the moon in shape or appearance
meanings.exampleEn: Her pale, moonlike face glowed in the darkness.
meanings.exampleTr: Solgun, ay gibi yüzü karanlıkta parlıyordu.

meanings.en: unhappy, bad-tempered, and unwilling to talk
meanings.exampleEn: He became morose and withdrawn after losing his job.
meanings.exampleTr: İşini kaybettikten sonra somurtkan ve içine kapanık biri oldu.

meanings.en: in an unhappy, bad-tempered, and silent way
meanings.exampleEn: He stared morosely out of the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Somurtarak pencereden dışarı baktı.

meanings.en: a small piece of food
meanings.exampleEn: She ate every last morsel on her plate.
meanings.exampleTr: Tabağındaki son lokmaya kadar her şeyi yedi.

meanings.en: liked or enjoyed by the greatest number of people
meanings.exampleEn: This is the most popular dish on the menu.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, menüdeki en popüler yemektir.

meanings.en: a person who rides a motorcycle
meanings.exampleEn: The motorcyclist swerved to avoid the truck.
meanings.exampleTr: Motosikletçi kamyondan kaçınmak için yön değiştirdi.

meanings.en: a soft green or grey growth that develops on old food or damp surfaces
meanings.exampleEn: There was mould growing on the bread.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekmeğin üzerinde küf oluşmuştu.

meanings.en: a hollow container used to give shape to a liquid or soft substance
meanings.exampleEn: Pour the mixture into the mould and let it set.
meanings.exampleTr: Karışımı kalıba dök ve donmasını bekle.

meanings.en: dirt, mud, or animal waste
meanings.exampleEn: The children came home covered in muck.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar pislik içinde eve geldi.

meanings.en: a state of confusion or disorder
meanings.exampleEn: The files are in a complete muddle.
meanings.exampleTr: Dosyalar tam bir karışıklık içinde.

meanings.en: to confuse or mix things up
meanings.exampleEn: Don't muddle the papers on my desk.
meanings.exampleTr: Masamdaki kağıtları karıştırma.

meanings.en: a fast-moving mass of wet earth and mud flowing down a slope
meanings.exampleEn: Heavy rain triggered a mudflow that buried several houses.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiddetli yağmur, birkaç evi gömen bir çamur seline yol açtı.

meanings.en: a curved cover over a wheel of a bicycle or vehicle that protects against mud and water
meanings.exampleEn: The bike's rear mudguard was splattered with dirt.
meanings.exampleTr: Bisikletin arka çamurluğu çamurla kaplanmıştı.

meanings.en: having many different aspects or features
meanings.exampleEn: Poverty is a multifaceted problem with no simple solution.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoksulluk, basit bir çözümü olmayan çok yönlü bir sorundur.

meanings.en: able to speak or using several different languages
meanings.exampleEn: She works as a multilingual customer support agent.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok dilli bir müşteri destek temsilcisi olarak çalışıyor.

meanings.en: a large number or great variety of something
meanings.exampleEn: There is a multiplicity of factors influencing the decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararı etkileyen çok sayıda faktör var.

meanings.en: a very large number of people or things
meanings.exampleEn: The new policy created a multitude of problems.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni politika çok sayıda soruna yol açtı.

meanings.en: very ordinary and therefore not interesting
meanings.exampleEn: He spends his days doing mundane office tasks.
meanings.exampleTr: Günlerini sıradan ofis işleri yaparak geçiriyor.

meanings.en: used to say that something is necessary or very important
meanings.exampleEn: You must finish the report by Friday.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu cuma gününe kadar bitirmelisin.

meanings.en: used to say that something is very likely or logically certain
meanings.exampleEn: You must be tired after such a long journey.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar uzun bir yolculuktan sonra yorgun olmalısın.

meanings.en: a person who takes part in a rebellion against a person in authority, especially soldiers or sailors
meanings.exampleEn: The mutineers seized control of the ship.
meanings.exampleTr: İsyancılar geminin kontrolünü ele geçirdi.

meanings.en: an act of refusing to obey the orders of people in authority, especially by soldiers or sailors
meanings.exampleEn: The crew staged a mutiny against the captain.
meanings.exampleTr: Mürettebat kaptana karşı bir isyan başlattı.

meanings.en: belonging to or connected with the speaker
meanings.exampleEn: This is my car.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu benim arabam.

meanings.en: a very large number of something
meanings.exampleEn: The city offers a myriad of entertainment options.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir sayısız eğlence seçeneği sunuyor.

meanings.en: used to refer back to the speaker as the object of an action they perform
meanings.exampleEn: I hurt myself while cooking.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemek yaparken kendimi yaraladım.

meanings.en: a person who tries to become united with God through prayer and meditation and to gain spiritual truths
meanings.exampleEn: The ancient mystic spent years meditating in the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Kadim mistik, dağlarda yıllarca meditasyon yaparak geçirdi.

meanings.en: the lowest or worst point of a situation
meanings.exampleEn: The company reached its nadir during the financial crisis.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, mali kriz sırasında en düşük noktasına ulaştı.

meanings.en: lack of experience, wisdom, or judgement
meanings.exampleEn: He was taken advantage of because of his naivety.
meanings.exampleTr: Saflığı yüzünden onu kullandılar.

meanings.en: made by a well-known and respected company
meanings.exampleEn: She only buys name-brand clothing.
meanings.exampleTr: Sadece markalı giysiler satın alıyor.

meanings.en: the state of having no name or of being unknown or anonymous
meanings.exampleEn: He preferred the namelessness of life in a big city.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük şehirdeki hayatın isimsizliğini tercih ediyordu.

meanings.en: the act of telling a story or the spoken commentary that accompanies a film or video
meanings.exampleEn: The documentary features narration by a famous actor.
meanings.exampleTr: Belgeselde ünlü bir aktörün anlatımı yer alıyor.

meanings.en: unwilling to accept ideas or ways of behaving that are different from your own
meanings.exampleEn: His narrow-minded views made discussion difficult.
meanings.exampleTr: Dar görüşlü fikirleri tartışmayı zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of being small in width, or of being limited in range or scope
meanings.exampleEn: The narrowness of the street made parking impossible.
meanings.exampleTr: Sokağın darlığı park etmeyi imkansız kılıyordu.

meanings.en: food that has not been processed or had artificial substances added to it
meanings.exampleEn: She prefers natural food without preservatives.
meanings.exampleTr: Koruyucu madde içermeyen doğal gıdaları tercih ediyor.

meanings.tr: düzeltti, derledi, topladı (neaten fiilinin geçmiş hali)
meanings.en: made something tidy or more orderly
meanings.exampleEn: She neatened the pile of papers on her desk.
meanings.exampleTr: Masasındaki kağıt yığınını topladı.

meanings.en: the act of causing something not to exist or to have no effect, or the opposite of something
meanings.exampleEn: War is the negation of peace and reason.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş, barışın ve aklın yadsınmasıdır.

meanings.en: an attitude that is not hopeful or enthusiastic and emphasizes bad things
meanings.exampleEn: His constant negativity brought down the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli olumsuzluğu bütün ekibin moralini bozdu.

meanings.en: not giving enough care or attention to someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: He was neglectful of his health for years.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca sağlığına karşı ihmalkâr davrandı.

meanings.en: too small or unimportant to be worth considering
meanings.exampleEn: The difference in price was negligible.
meanings.exampleTr: Fiyat farkı ihmal edilebilir düzeydeydi.

meanings.en: located or living near or next to a place or person
meanings.exampleEn: People came from neighbouring towns to attend the festival.
meanings.exampleTr: Festivale katılmak için komşu kasabalardan insanlar geldi.

meanings.en: a medical state involving anxiety, nervousness, or a disorder of the nerves
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor said her nervous condition required rest.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor, sinirsel rahatsızlığının dinlenme gerektirdiğini söyledi.

meanings.en: the quality of being new, recent, or not existing before
meanings.exampleEn: The newness of the technology made people hesitant.
meanings.exampleTr: Teknolojinin yeniliği insanları tereddütte bıraktı.

meanings.en: a spoken or written account of a recent event in the news
meanings.exampleEn: A news report confirmed the earthquake had caused major damage.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir haber, depremin büyük hasara yol açtığını doğruladı.

meanings.en: at the side of; beside
meanings.exampleEn: She sat next to me during the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı sırasında yanıma oturdu.

meanings.en: clothes worn in bed or for sleeping
meanings.exampleEn: The store has a new collection of nightwear.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağazada yeni bir gece kıyafeti koleksiyonu var.
